name: dhan-options-bot
description: Layered options signal scanner + paper-trading bot for DhanHQ v2 (NIFTY / SENSEX / Stock F&O): deterministic strategy registry, optional Tev1 model selection via ollama-sdk, hard risk gate. Signals only - never places real orders.

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js scan
scripts.scan: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js scan
scripts.chain: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js chain
scripts.backtest: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js backtest
scripts.report: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js report
scripts.selftest: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js selftest
